result.summary: Found 3 issues: duplicate Green Bowl Poké cards in Fastest near you, a truncated restaurant name, and bottom content clipped by the tab bar.

issues.description: Duplicate listing in 'Fastest near you': 'Green Bowl Poké' appears twice consecutively with identical image, time (15-25 min) and delivery fee (€0.90 delivery).
issues.suggestion: De-duplicate restaurant feed so each venue appears once; verify list data source and rendering logic.

issues.description: Restaurant name truncated as 'Smash Bros Bu' without ellipsis in 'Fastest near you' carousel.
issues.suggestion: Ensure card titles wrap or truncate with ellipsis and provide enough card width/padding so full name is readable when scrolled into view.

issues.description: Bottom 'Popular right now' pizza card is clipped by the bottom tab bar with no restaurant name, metadata or spacing visible.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding and safe-area inset to scroll view so last card and its details are fully visible above the Home/Search/Orders/Profile bar.
